biography.plain_text: Igor Simčič is a Slovenian businessman who founded the international chemical distributor Esimit in 1978 and later sold it to Warwick. He retains a majority stake in Euroholding, whose management passed to his son Simon. From a winemaking family in Brda, he also created the European sailing project Esimit Europa.

long_biography.plain_text:
Slovenian entrepreneur Igor Simčič conceived a cross-border sailing team while commuting between his home in Solkan and his business in Gorizia. Repeated border formalities prompted him to approach both mayors in 1995. He proposed displaying the two cities' names in opposite orders on either side of a racing boat, joined by European stars.

The Slovenian mayor supplied money to launch the project, which subsequently gained backing from the European Parliament and European Commission. European institutions supplied political backing, while commercial sponsorship financed expansion. With Gazprom's backing, he assembled an international crew led by triple Olympic champion Jochen Schümann. The team brought together sailors of eleven nationalities.
